name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
description:
Received from Alice, this dictionary was created by the witches. Though it claims to explain a storybook of fables titled The Little Witch and the Undying Fire, it is actually filled with homework tailored by the Hexenzirkel for each reader.
As they say, "To defy the current is to learn." Embark on your journey with your companions and seek the crown of elevation!
